description: Report whether a price from compute_price was used. Pass receipt.id from that result as usage_event_id. Outcomes are what later routing and confidence learn from. With outcome pricing on, a rejection within the call's outcome window gives back part of what it cost; the result says what was refunded. Needs a Last Price credential. Report only what actually happened.

evidence_note.description: Optional evidence: a short note on why.

evidence_reference.description: Optional evidence: an order, ticket or invoice id in your own system.

evidence_url.description: Optional evidence: an https link to the record.

quality_score.description: Optional: how good the price was, 0 to 1.

usage_event_id.description: The usage event of the priced call: receipt.id on the compute_price result.

name: report_outcome
